summary: Shows extracting nested keys from a dictionary for a list of selected keys using map('extract'), map(attribute=...) and flatten, and getting a unique list of a variable across all hosts from hostvars.
questions: How do I pull a nested value out of a dict for several keys in Jinja2?
How do I get a unique list of a variable's values across all hosts?
How does the extract filter work with hostvars?

answer_card.title: Extracting values with map('extract')
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
msg: "{{ chains | map('extract', chains_config) | map(attribute='configs') | flatten | map(attribute='type') | flatten }}"
```

With `chains: [1, 2]` this returns `["routed", "bridged", "routed", "bridged"]`.

Unique values of a var across all hosts:

```yaml
unique_value_list: "{{ groups['all'] | map('extract', hostvars, 'varname') | list | unique }}"
```
